items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: But I think Henry Woods wrote the music and the words, I think.

ctx.x: And singer. Was he in -- it seems like I've seen where he's gotten credit -- partial credit for 'Rosetta.' Did he write the words?
He didn't write the words. He got credit for singing it. But I think Henry Woods wrote the music and the words, I think.
